title: Long-form YouTube editor, finance channel, monthly retainer
description:
I am a creator who runs a finance, AI, and business YouTube channel (youtube.com/@shaheeransari) with 10 to 50 minute talking-head, screen sharing tutorial and online podcast videos. I need one editor on a monthly retainer to take over the editing of my videos completely: My requirements in a month are [3 to 4] long videos and 10 to 15 vertical clips a month from raw footage and an outline.

You should have edited talking-head or podcast content before and be comfortable with captions, simple charts or B-rolls, motions, animations, and clean pacing. Premiere or DaVinci, or any other editor is your choice as I would like to focus on the results and not the tools you use. I can send over raw recorded footages and we can agree on the style of edited video I am looking for before we start.

To apply, please send two links to long-form edits you have done and your monthly rate for the volume above. I will pick two or three people for a test edit of one 1-5-minute video first, then offer the ongoing role to one.

title: Police Bodycam You Tube Video Editor
description:
Title: Police Body Cam YouTube Video Editor, Proven Results Required (3 Videos/Week)

Description:
DO NOT APPLY unless you can show proven results editing police body cam YouTube channels. No exceptions. Generic video editors will be declined.

You will:

-Edit long-form body cam videos with tight pacing that keeps viewers watching (15-23 mins).
-Add captions, graphics, text overlays, and highlights that guide viewers through the footage.
-Blur or censor faces, names, license plates, and other sensitive details.
-Mix voiceover, footage audio, music, and sound effects cleanly.
-Color correct and export in the right format for YouTube
Deliver on deadline and apply revisions quickly.

You must have:

-Proven success editing body cam or true crime YouTube channels, past or current.
-Links to videos you edited, plus results if you can share them (views, retention, growth).
-Strong skills in Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or a similar editor, and After Effects for graphics.
-Reliable communication and a consistent weekly turnaround.

To apply, include:

-Links to 2-3 body cam videos you edited.
-How long you’ve been editing, and how long in the body cam or true crime niche.
-Your rate and weekly availability.

Start your cover letter with “BODYCAM” so we know you read this.

Skills tags: YouTube Video Editing, Video Editing, Video Post-Production, Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, Color Correction, Sound Design, Subtitles & Captions, True Crime.

title: Long-Form Video Editor — True Crime / Documentary YouTube Channel (Ongoing)
description:
I run a true crime documentary YouTube channel and I’m looking for a reliable long-form editor for an ongoing role. You’ll turn supplied material — voiceover narration, a script, and provided footage — into polished, retention-focused episodes in a cinematic documentary style.

Channel: https://youtu.be/ug6Rw6l-oUg?si=x_t4-ijxk2W5rP5w

What you’ll do

Edit long-form videos (~[30–60] min) from narration + provided footage
Build pacing and tension that holds viewer retention
Sync footage, animations and b-roll to the voiceover/script
Add captions/subtitles, lower-thirds, light motion graphics, sound design, and music
Basic color correction and audio cleanup
Deliver clean project files on a consistent schedule

Requirements

Proven experience editing long-form true crime, documentary, or narrative YouTube content
Proficient in [Premiere Pro / DaVinci Resolve] (After Effects a plus)
Strong sense of storytelling, pacing, and retention editing
Reliable communication and deadline discipline
Able to handle an ongoing volume of 4 videos per month!

To apply

Share 1–2 links to videos you personally edited that are closest to this style — tell me which parts were your work
Name the software you use and your typical turnaround time per long-form video
One line on your current availability

title: English Voiceover Artist for Long-Form Faceless YouTube Videos
description:
I'm looking for an English voiceover artist to narrate documentary-style videos for a faceless YouTube channel about true crime, history and finance stories.

What I need:

- Narration for long-form YouTube videos (about 1,500–2,500 words per script)
- A calm, clear and engaging storytelling voice, like a documentary narrator
- Clean, professional audio with no background noise, delivered as WAV or MP3
- Natural pacing, with emotion and emphasis where the story calls for it

What I provide:

- A finished script for each video
- Notes on tone and pronunciation of names when needed

Requirements:

- Fluent, clear English; any accent is welcome, including European and other international accents, as long as you're easy to understand
- Good mic and a quiet recording space
- Real human voice only; no AI voices
- Reliable turnaround, ideally within 2–3 days per script
- Full commercial rights to the recordings transferred to me

Please send a short sample of your narration (documentary style if possible), your rate per finished minute or per script, and your usual turnaround time.

title: Scriptwriter for Long-Form Faceless YouTube Videos
description:
**Scriptwriter for Long-Form Faceless YouTube Videos**

I'm looking for an experienced scriptwriter for a faceless YouTube channel that makes documentary-style true crime and history videos.

**What I need:**

- Full scripts for long-form YouTube videos (8–15 minutes)
- Strong storytelling: clear structure, a hook in the first 30 seconds, and a strong ending
- Writing that works for narration over visuals (no talking-head style)
- Accurate research and fact-checking, with sources listed

**What I provide:**

- Topic and angle for each video
- Style references and examples of channels we want to match
- Feedback and revisions on the outline and draft

**Requirements:**

- Proven samples of long-form YouTube or documentary scripts
- Comfortable with true crime, history, or similar documentary topics
- Reliable and able to meet deadlines
- All work must be original, with full rights transferred to me

Please send 1–2 sample scripts or links, your rate per script, and your typical turnaround time.

title: Video Editor for Faceless Movie Recap Channel (Long-Term, High Volume)
description:
I run a faceless YouTube channel that publishes movie and TV recap videos. I already write the script and record the voiceover — your job is purely the edit. I hand you the VO audio, the script, and the source movie/show file, and you turn it into a clean, watchable 10–20 minute recap video.

This is ongoing work with steady volume. I'm looking for one or two reliable editors to grow with long-term, not a one-off gig. Start with a paid trial video, and if it's a fit we'll move to a consistent weekly schedule. 

To apply, please include:
A link to 1–2 recap or faceless-style videos you've edited (this matters more than anything else — no portfolio, no reply)
Your turnaround time for a 15-minute recap
How many videos per week you can comfortably handle
Confirm you're good with the $0.75 per finished minute rate

title: Make faceless math videos - like Khan Academy
description:
Hi,

My name is Elliott. I own an exam preparation company and I'm looking for math tutor who feels comfortable completing secondary-level math questions by recording walk-through videos on a tablet device using a digital pencil (like Khan Academy style.)

Here is the job:
1. I provide you with a PDF of math questions (see example attached).

2. You complete the math problems to ensure they are correct (meaning, there is one and only one correct answer option for each question).

3. You use a tablet device, digital pencil, and a plug-in microphone to screen record (faceless) instructional videos on how to complete these questions for my students.

I pay $3 per question that you record a video for. I have about 10 lessons that each have about 10 questions, so a total of 100 questions that need to be recorded. 

This job is totally asynchronous, but I want to hire someone who is available to start ASAP, and can record the videos quickly.

If you are interested, I'd like you to do two things:
1. Share a photo of your microphone (it does not have to be an expensive one, but you do need an external microphone that plugs into your tablet device.)
2. Pick one question from the PDF attached. Record yourself completing the one question, and send me a link to review your instruction.

I'm happy to answer any questions you have, and look forward to  speaking with you.

Elliott

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_HtqL42aR0nvyweqouk6ZommHFlSc2l8/view?usp=sharing
